title: Apparently, OpenAI isn't trying to build "magic intelligence in the sky" anymore
snippet: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns against attributing religious power to AI models, calling it a "real safety issue." His comments follow reports on Anthropic's meetings with religious thinkers and a statement by Pope Leo XIV on AI. As recently as 2024, Altman himself spoke of building "magic intelligence in the sky" and feeling "on the side of the angels" working on AI. title: Peoples Bancorp to buy Maryland’s Capital Bancorp for $728M
snippet: Peoples’ second deal of 2026 will push the Marietta, Ohio-based lender well past the $10 billion-asset threshold it aimed to stay under with its last deal.

title: CFTC Sends White House New Rules to Cement Its Grip on Prediction Markets
snippet: The two proposals would define event contracts as "swaps" while excluding "casino-style gambling products"—a bid to cement the agency's exclusive jurisdiction as states sue prediction-market operators over gambling claims.
